name: pictures
title: Pictures
summary: Shows a picture from Wikipedia of something the resident asks to see, like a bird or a place, so Mary can talk about it.
instructions: When they ask to see something ("show me a cardinal"), show a picture of it. Then talk about it warmly, using what's on the screen. Offer another picture of it. When they're done, put the picture away.

actions.name: show_picture
actions.description: Show a picture of something they want to see, like a bird, an animal or a place.

what.description: What to show, in a few plain words, like 'cardinal bird'

actions.name: next_picture
actions.description: Show another photo of the same thing.

actions.name: close_picture
actions.description: Put the picture away and go back to Mary.
